translations.web: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.
translations.bsb: As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.
translations.kjv: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.
translations.asv: As for me, I shall behold thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with beholding thy form. Psalm 18 For the Chief Musician.
